description: returns values shared by two JSON arrays in left-side order using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json array intersection result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Array Intersection as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

left.description: Left supplied to JSON Array Intersection; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

right.description: Right supplied to JSON Array Intersection; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_json_array_intersection
